title: Incident versus prevalent progressive supranuclear palsy: analyses of U.S. Alzheimer’s Disease Research Centers data indicate clinical and neuropathological features of a relatively common and underrecognized tauopathy in the aging brain
title_zh: 特发性与流行性进行性上行性麻痹：美国阿尔茨海默病研究中心数据分析提示衰老大脑中一种相对常见且鲜为人知的tau病理
abstract: Progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP) is an adult-onset neurodegenerative disease with a heterogeneous spectrum of clinical and pathological features. The epidemiology of PSP-as defined by the gold standard of autopsy diagnosis-remains unresolved, but prevalence estimates are typically ~1:10,000. Here, we analyzed the National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center (NACC) Neuropathology Data Set, aggregated from 38 U.S. Alzheimer's Disease Research Centers (ADRCs). We compared clinical and neuropathologic features of autopsied participants, stratifying on cognitive status at recruitment into the cohort. The sample comprised 6845 individuals who were followed longitudinally for 4.0 (± 2.9 stdev) approximately yearly visits, n = 297 with eventual autopsy-verified PSP. Participants were not necessarily diagnosed or followed in movement disorder clinics. Among those with dementia or PSP at recruitment (n = 4310), 3.3% had corticobasal degeneration (CBD), 3.0% Pick's disease, and 4.5% PSP pathology. Among those recruited while cognitively normal (n = 1451), 0.7% had CBD, and 0.1% Pick's disease, while 3.2% had PSP pathology. This frequency of incident PSP pathology was higher than expected based on prior epidemiology studies. In comparing between incident (recruited normal) and prevalent (recruited with dementia or clinical PSP) cases with PSP pathology, those with incident PSP died older: 89.5 years vs 76.3 years on average. Furthermore, incident PSP pathology cases were less likely to manifest stereotypical PSP clinical features, but more likely to have parkinsonism. In a convenience sample of individuals with PSP pathology from the University of Kentucky ADRC (n = 23), digital pathology analyses using HALO software and AI-based analytic modules revealed that PSP tau pathology was more severe overall in prevalent PSP. Within the putamen, incident cases had a higher proportion of tufted astrocytes and lower proportion of NFTs. In conclusion, in this large multicenter sample, PSP pathology was more common than other FTLD-Tau subtypes, and incident PSP often differed clinically from "classic" PSP.
abstract_zh: 进行性上行性麻痹（PSP）是一种成年发病的神经退行性疾病，具有异质性的临床和病理特征。以尸检诊断为金标准的PSP流行病学特征尚未完全阐明，但流行病学估计值通常为每1万人约1例。本研究分析了由38家美国阿尔茨海默病研究中心汇总的国家阿尔茨海默病协调中心（NACC）尸检数据集。我们比较了随 cohort 入组时认知状态分类的尸检参与者的临床和病理特征。样本包括6845名随访4.0（±2.9个标准差）约每年一次的访问者，其中297例最终证实了尸检诊断的PSP。参与者不一定在运动障碍诊所接受诊断或随访。在入组时患有痴呆或PSP（n=4310）的个体中，3.3%患有顶叶叶变性（CBD），3.0%患有匹克氏病，4.5%患有PSP病理。在入组时认知正常（n=1451）的个体中，0.7%患有CBD，0.1%患有匹克氏病，而3.2%患有PSP病理。与先前流行病学研究的预期相比，此类PSP病理的发病频率更高。在比较入组时认知正常（发病例）和入组时患有痴呆或临床PSP（流行例）的PSP病理病例时，发病例平均死亡年龄更大：89.5岁 vs 76.3岁。此外，发病例不太可能表现出典型的PSP临床特征，但更可能出现帕金森主义。在肯塔基大学ADRC的一份便利样本中，有PSP病理的个体（n=23），使用HALO软件进行数字病理分析和基于AI的分析模块显示，PSP tau病理在流行性PSP中整体严重程度更高。在丘脑中，发病例具有更高比例的簇状星形胶质细胞和更低比例的神经纤维缠结。总之，在该大规模多中心样本中，PSP病理比其他FTLD-Tau亚型更常见，且发病例在临床表现上常与“典型”PSP有所不同。
